# The Legend of Trump

> Unofficial, independent low-poly third-person browser adventure game built with React 19, Three.js, React Three Fiber, TypeScript and Vite. Characters, gear and scenes are independently rebuilt assets; no reference videos or original models are included.

- Repository: https://github.com/jammyfu/TheLegendOfTrump
- READMEs: Simplified Chinese (default), Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean.

## Run
Node.js 22.12+ and a WebGL 2 browser: `npm ci && npm run dev`. `npm run build` outputs a static `dist/` with no backend.
